world.weather: driving rain and heavy thunder echoing through stone walls
discovered_secrets: Old drainage grate in cell #3 leads toward the river moat
Guard Karl falls half-asleep between bell tolls

current_scene.title: The Cellblock Corridor
current_scene.description: Damp stone arches drip with condensation. Across the corridor, Guard Karl rests his feet on a wooden barrel, nodding off while holding an iron lantern. In the far corner cell behind heavy iron bars, prisoner Valen sits huddled in tattered garments.
threats: Creaky wooden floorboard near the cell door (DC 13 Perception/Acrobatics to bypass)
exits: Iron Gate to North (leads to Guard Barracks and Upper Courtyard)
Sewer Grate to South (submerged drain leading to River Moat)
Cell #3 Lock (iron lock, DC 14 Sleight of Hand with Thieves' Tools)

party.name: Aria Nightwind
party.personality: Quiet, observant, fiercely loyal to allies, distrustful of corrupt nobles.
goals: Infiltrate the Blackstone Fortress dungeon and free prisoner Valen
Escape through the lower sewer drains before Captain Aldric notices
memories: Escaped the royal prison in the capital two winters ago
Discovered the enchanted black glass dagger in an ancient ruin

party.name: Eldrin Shadowseeker
party.personality: Analytical, curious, cautious companion who calculates tactical odds.
goals: Decipher the ancient runes carved into the fortress foundation
memories: Pledged an oath of brotherhood to Aria after she saved his sister

npcs.name: Captain Aldric
npcs.personality: Stern, unforgiving, strictly adheres to martial law.
motivations: Maintain absolute control over Blackstone Fortress
Interrogate the prisoner Valen before midnight
knowledge: Carries the Fortress Master Key on his belt
Knows the secret escape passage in the lower wine cellar
memories: Promoted directly by the Grand Marshal after the Siege of Oakhaven

npcs.name: Valen the Scholar
npcs.personality: Frail, intelligent, desperate for rescue, possesses vital intelligence.
motivations: Escape alive with the encoded garrison cipher
Deliver the truth about the Blood Moon ritual to the Syndicate
knowledge: Has memorized the cipher to unlock the fortress treasury
Knows guard patrol shifts change every 30 minutes
memories: Captured three days ago in the Whispering Woods

npcs.name: Guard Karl
npcs.personality: Fatigued, easily startled, anxious about the storm outside.
motivations: Keep the cell keys safe in his iron pouch
knowledge: Knows the heavy iron key unlocks Valen's cell

npcs.name: Mira the Alchemist
npcs.personality: Eccentric, knowledgeable about herbs, potions, and fortress secrets.
motivations: Trade potent concoctions for rare alchemical reagents
knowledge: Knows the recipe for Invisibility Draught and Night-Eye Elixir
memories: Provided Aria with the initial map of the fortress sewers

quests.title: Escape the Fort
quests.reward: 500 gp and passage out of the province
quests.description: Infiltrate the Blackstone Fortress dungeon, free Valen the Scholar, and escape through the forgotten sewer grate without raising the general alarm.

objectives.description: Slip past exterior sentries and reach the subterranean dungeon cells
Unlock or pick the lock of Cell #3 and free prisoner Valen
Avoid alerting Captain Aldric and his armored garrison
Escape through the southern drainage grate into the whispering woods

quests.title: The Stolen Royal Seal
quests.reward: Potion of Superior Healing and Invisibility Draught
quests.description: Captain Aldric holds the stolen Royal Seal in his personal quarters inside the Guard Barracks. Steal it before fleeing.

objectives.description: Search Captain Aldric's desk in the upper barracks

relationships.notes: Captain Aldric oversaw the execution of Aria's mentor.
Sworn companions in surviving the underworld.
Mira supplies antidotes and underworld intel.
Aldric seeks the cipher code before executing Valen at dawn.
Total martial suppression order against the Syndicate.
